issues.problem: The microwave is substantially wider and more than twice as deep as its supporting cabinet, leaving it precariously overhanging and impractical to use safely.
issues.fix: Move the microwave to a counter or cabinet at least as wide and deep as the appliance.

issues.problem: The faucet is mounted on a plain cabinet with no sink or basin and faces toward the wall, so it has no usable function.
issues.fix: Install it with a sink basin on a suitable counter and rotate it to serve the basin from the room-facing side.

issues.problem: The oven and large cabinet obstruct the lower portions and access sides of two windows.
issues.fix: Reconfigure this cabinet-and-oven run onto solid wall sections while keeping the oven between obj_0004 and obj_0029 as required.

issues.problem: The dishwasher is across the room from the faucet/washing area, creating an inconvenient workflow and separating appliances that normally share plumbing.
issues.fix: Move the dishwasher beside or near the completed sink cabinet.
